body:
OBSERVED FLAKE, 2026-09-03, during T263 PR 8's bar: test/server/loam-docs.test.ts failed once with a build-docs refusal naming topic "Bad_Topic", then passed on a re-run and in isolation.

ATTRIBUTION IS COMPLETE. Two test files share one directory in the real repo tree.
- The writer: test/server/docs-quick-start.test.ts writes docs/Bad_Topic.md, runs the generator, and removes it. That file is a frozen rail of archived T250.
- The reader: test/server/loam-docs.test.ts runs `node scripts/build-docs.mjs --check` and expects the verdict line.
Vitest runs the two files in different workers at the same time. When the reader's child process starts inside the writer's window, the generator meets the stray file and throws. Neither test is wrong. The shared state is.

THE FIX IS BLOCKED BY THE FREEZE, which is why this is a ticket and not a same-day repair. The writer is frozen, so a lock cannot be taken on both sides. The reader's subject is the REAL tree, so it cannot move to a copy without weakening what it proves. The lever left is scheduling: the two files must not run at the same time. Vitest projects with different sequence.groupOrder run sequentially; that is the candidate.

Acceptance criteria:
(a) The two files never run concurrently, proven by a mechanism a reader can see in the config rather than by a passing run. Verify: a case that reads the scheduling declaration and names both files.
(b) Neither assertion is weakened. The writer still proves the generator refuses a bad topic name. The reader still proves the committed module regenerates byte-identically through the real CLI with its verdict spoken. Verify: test/server/loam-docs.test.ts and test/server/docs-quick-start.test.ts, unchanged and green.
(c) No retry, no widened assertion, no skip. Verify: the diff.

Merge tier: a test-infrastructure repair. The model self-merges on green.
title: Stop two docs rails racing on the real docs/ directory
